I am a first year student in the [Master of Business Analytics](https://www.monash.edu/business/master-of-business-analytics) at Monash University. I am also a Senior Associate Director with [PropNex Singapore](https://www.propnex.com/), where I analyse Singapore property market data to help clients compare developments and plan their portfolios.

Outside of property, I explore data wherever it leads. *Downstream* is about the effects that follow. Every dataset shapes a decision somewhere further along, and I'm interested in tracing those links.
